facts.rationale: Correct the canonical indexed member and distinguish a level predicate from historical input detection.
facts.value: Reads Fighter.input.lstick[0].x through the supplied Fighter_GObj, negates the local float only when it is below zero, and compares it strictly against p_ftCommonData->x58_someLStickXThreshold. A successful comparison forwards the original object to ftCo_RunBrake_Enter before returning true; otherwise returns false without entry. This reads only current input and does not locally test running/ground state or an input-release edge.

evidence.why: Both gate branches, unchanged phase on resume, float maintenance and negated conjunction are explicit.

facts.rationale: Preserve exact gate and timer semantics without claiming a universal saturating countdown.
facts.value: When cmd_vars[1] is nonzero, false runbrake.x0 permits rate-zero freezing at ABS(gr_vel) >= x42C and sets x0 true. The true branch permits rate-one resumption at ABS(gr_vel) <= x42C, clearing cmd_vars[1] but leaving x0 true. Equality can freeze on one callback and resume on a later callback, not both in one invocation. Independently, a truthy float timer has 1.0F subtracted and a negative result clamped to zero. The exit helper ft_8008A2BC runs unless both animation frames and timer truth remain. Ordinary small finite nonnegative timers count down to zero; NaN and positive infinity do not, and large finite values may fail to decrement due to rounding. Ordered velocity comparisons do not trigger on NaN.

facts.rationale: Include the optional early jump-helper branch and exact downstream input boundaries.
facts.value: Forwards the same Fighter_GObj through fn_800CAF78, then only if cmd_vars[0] is nonzero through fn_800C9CEC, then through ftCo_800D5FB0, returning immediately on a truthy result. The first helper checks ftCo_800C5240 and may delegate to ftCo_800C5A50 before normal jump inputs; otherwise vertical stick >= relaxed_tap_jump_threshold with tilt timer < tap_jump_window, or pressed X/Y, enters KneeBend. The TurnRun helper compares lstick[0].x * facing_dir <= x38_someLStickXThreshold and forwards cur_anim_frame to TurnRun entry. The final helper enters Squat when lstick[0].y < -x90. Alternate first-helper semantics and tuning values are not inferred from names.
